snippet.title: Halloween Decoration Sandbox - Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Patch 1.1 Beta is now live.
New features include a Tombstone Customize tool, ability to paint textures on terrain, and tons of bug fixes, improved camera controls and the ability to load height maps from TGA, PNG, or JPG images
VR support coming soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1438750/Halloween_Decoration_Sandbox

https://twitter.com/HalloweenSandbx
https://techskullgames.weebly.com/
